_readme: Per-domain submission profiles. 'automation' is 'manual_only' to forbid automatic submission for that domain, or 'allowed' to permit it when every generic safety check also passes. 'field_map' maps a form field name to one of: url, name, description, email, keywords, category, or a literal value prefixed with 'literal:'. Unknown domains are never auto-submitted unless the form passes all generic checks AND you approve the opportunity.

producthunt.com.notes: Account and human launch process required.

github.com.notes: Use your own account; pull requests must be written by a person.
